interface.description: Network interface to send requests and receive responses on (required: -i/--ifname)

dstmac.description: Destination MAC address for DHCP requests; empty string uses broadcast (optional: -d/--dstmac)

exclude_servers.description: List of server IP addresses to ignore (optional: -e/--exclude). Each item must be a valid IPv4 or IPv6 address.

promiscuous.description: Whether to set interface to promiscuous mode (optional: -p/--no-promisc negates this)
